input: Learn basic sign language greetings and phrases

gold.taskTitle: Learn Basic Sign Language Greetings and Phrases
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to learn foundational sign language greetings and common phrases to communicate at a basic level.

questions.title: Which sign language are you learning, e.g. ASL, BSL?
questions.description: Identify the specific sign language system the user wants to learn, as they vary significantly by country and region.

questions.title: What is driving you to learn sign language right now?
questions.description: Understand the motivation behind the goal, such as connecting with a deaf friend, family member, coworker, or personal interest.

questions.title: Who will you primarily be signing with?
questions.description: Clarify the intended communication partner, whether a specific person or a general audience, to tailor phrase selection appropriately.

questions.title: How many phrases do you consider basically enough?
questions.description: Determine the scope of the learning goal, such as 10 phrases, 25 phrases, or enough to hold a short conversation.

questions.title: What is your target date to reach this goal?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or timeframe so a realistic and paced learning plan can be structured.

questions.title: How much time per day can you dedicate to practice?
questions.description: Understand the user's available daily practice window to set a manageable and consistent learning schedule.

questions.title: Do you prefer video-based learning or written guides?
questions.description: Identify the user's preferred learning format to recommend the most suitable resources and practice methods.
